questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: A Dutch project that tackles loneliness with soup
How to make healthy soup at home
Why students in the Netherlands have so much free time
How pets can help people feel less lonely
questions.why: They discuss loneliness and hear about Oma's Soup, a project in the Netherlands.

questions.q: Why is Beth feeling sad at the start?
options: Her cat is ill
She has too much work
She has been feeling lonely
She has moved to a new city
questions.why: She's been spending lots of time with her cat and house plants and feels a bit lonely.

questions.q: What has research shown about loneliness?
options: It mostly affects young people who live in cities
It raises the risk of illnesses like dementia
It only lasts a short time
It is less common in cities
questions.why: Beth says it puts people at greater risk of health issues including dementia and heart disease.

questions.q: What point does Neil make about being alone?
options: People who live alone are always lonely
Being alone is bad for everyone
Loneliness only ever happens to elderly people who live alone
You can feel lonely even when surrounded by people
questions.why: He says some people are surrounded by people but still feel disconnected.

questions.q: How does Myra Anubi describe loneliness?
options: Enjoying time on your own
Being too busy to see friends
Wanting company but finding it hard to connect
Living a long way away from your family and old friends
questions.why: She says it's when you crave people's company and find it hard to connect.

questions.q: Why did Bep de Bruin's story shock the Netherlands?
options: Nobody noticed she had died for about 10 years
She was the oldest woman living in the whole of Rotterdam
She started the first soup kitchen
She had lost all her money
questions.why: She was found dead in 2013, but she had been dead for 10 years.

questions.q: Why did Max and Martijn start Oma's Soup?
options: They wanted to open their own soup restaurant in Rotterdam
Their university asked them to
They needed jobs for the summer
Older people were lonely, and students had free time
questions.why: Claire Bates says they were concerned about their grandparents' generation and had friends with free time.

questions.q: Why does Beth mention that the project has spread to Rotterdam?
options: To show that the project is in trouble
To show Bep's death led to something hopeful
To explain where the soup is made
To say that Rotterdam has the most lonely people
questions.why: She says Rotterdam was Bep's hometown, making her death the spark for something more hopeful.
